messages.subject: [D-RUG]: First work session April 4th, 12-2pm
parts:
Hi Folks,

Welcome back to Spring Term! We will be starting up our weekly work sessions tomorrow, April 4th from 12-2pm in 360 Shields Library (the DSI space). This will be our meeting time for all of Spring term. We have some great presentation lined up for this term, and as usual, lots of awesome helpers to assist with any and all R questions! We hope to see you there!

Cheers,
Martha, Michael, Ryan and Taylor
